name: draft_cand_0151_rate_family_aggregation_selector
query: # receivers -> processor label_join(label_replace(label_join((sum(rate(harness_requests_total{job="api"}[5m])) by(service)) ,"source", "-rcv-", "transport", "receiver") ,"target", "processor", "", "") , "id", "-", "source", "target") # processor -> exporters or label_join(label_replace(label_join((sum(rate(harness_requests_total{job="api"}[5m])) by(service)) , "target", "-exp-", "transport", "exporter") , "source", "processor", "", "") , "id", "-", "source", "target")

name: draft_cand_0053_rate_family_vector_matching_aggregation_selector
query: sum by(namespace) (rate(harness_requests_total{job="api",namespace!=""}[5m]) * on(job, namespace, pod) group_left topk by(job, namespace, pod) (1, max by(job, namespace, pod) (harness_up{job="api"})))
